_comment: Copy to models.local.json (git-ignored, per machine). /model-order edits it; scripts/Get-ModelOrder.ps1 -Show prints the effective order. Fill the openai ids from `opencode models openai`; a name whose id still contains '<' is dropped from every chain.

claude-full._comment: Claude credit available: OpenCode cheap tier implements, Claude reviews tasks, GLM reviews plan PRs.

claude-low._comment: Claude credit low: OpenCode implements and reviews; the reviewer chain skips the implementer's vendor.

opencode-low._comment: OpenCode credit low: OpenAI through OpenCode implements, Claude reviews tasks; gpt reviews plan PRs it did not implement.
